relationships.subject: LYVE1+CX3CR1+ synovial macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: LYVE1+CX3CR1+ macrophages orchestrated neutrophil recruitment and activated calcitonin gene-related peptide+ (CGRP+) nociceptor neurons via interleukin-1β

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: formed tight clusters around PV1+ capillaries in response to systemic immune stimuli, a feature enhanced by nociceptor-derived CGRP

key_findings: PV1+ fenestrated capillaries at the synovial lining-sublining interface let circulating immune complexes access the synovium
Subset-specific macrophage-nociceptor crosstalk (IL-1beta, CGRP) forms a blood-joint barrier sentinel unit
